cues.text: Outside the dorm, at the foot of its front steps. You and Shinjiro walk up just as Mitsuru steps over to meet you, her bag in hand.
Akihiko walks up to the three of you.
Shinjiro turns away and goes up the steps into the dorm; the door shuts behind him.
Mitsuru turns and hurries into the dorm after him, leaving you and Akihiko outside.
You turn and walk past Akihiko into the dorm, leaving him standing outside.
